mapper.select:
select
,wm.module_classify AS bussiness_key_name, db.name AS source_platform, tpe.name AS third_process_definition_name from cfg_third_process as ctp LEFT JOIN public.work_menu wm ON wm.module_code = ctp.bussiness_key AND wm.is_deleted = false LEFT JOIN public.dict_basic db ON db.type = 'sourcePlatform' AND db.is_deleted = false AND db.value = ctp.source_platform LEFT JOIN public.third_process_definition AS tpe ON tpe.approval_code= ctp.third_process_definition_code AND tpe.is_deleted = false where ${params.sqlMap.default} and ctp.is_deleted = false
${params.permissionSql}
order by ctp.create_time desc

SELECT -- 主表字段 p.id AS process_id, p.code AS process_code, p.name AS process_name, p.bussiness_key AS process_bussiness_key, p.operate_type AS process_operate_type, p.source_platform AS process_source_platform, p.enable_status AS process_enable_status, p.enable_time AS process_enable_time, p.third_process_definition_code AS thirdProcessDefinitionCode,
-- 字段映射表字段 fm.id AS field_map_id, fm.third_field AS field_map_third_field, fm.third_field_type AS field_map_third_field_type, fm.third_field_required AS field_map_third_field_required, fm.sys_field AS field_map_sys_field, fm.sys_field_type AS field_map_sys_field_type, fm.sys_field_required AS field_map_sys_field_required, fm.cfg_id AS field_map_cfg_id, fm.default_value AS field_map_default_value, fm.is_unique AS field_map_is_unique, fm.cfg_type AS field_map_cfg_type, fm.third_field_id AS field_map_third_field_id, fm.is_detail_field AS field_map_is_detail_field, fm.third_parent_id AS field_map_parent_id, fm.group_type AS field_map_group_type, fm.sys_parent_id AS sys_parent_id, fm.index AS field_map_index, b1.value AS thirdFieldTypeName, b2.value AS sysFieldTypeName,
-- 值映射表字段 vm.id AS value_map_id, vm.field_map_id AS value_map_field_map_id, vm.third_value AS value_map_third_value, vm.sys_value AS value_map_sys_value, vm.default_value AS value_map_default_value
FROM cfg_third_process p LEFT JOIN cfg_process_field_map fm ON p.id = fm.cfg_id AND fm.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN cfg_process_value_map vm ON fm.id = vm.field_map_id AND vm.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN dict_basic b1 ON b1.type = 'field_type' AND b1.name = fm.third_field_type AND b1.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN dict_basic b2 ON b2.type = 'field_type' AND b2.name = fm.sys_field_type AND b2.is_deleted = FALSE
WHERE p.id = #{id} And p.is_deleted = FALSE ORDER BY fm.create_time ASC
